decision_rationale: Provider-scoped cooldown, bounded in-flight coordination, capacity fail-closed behavior and jittered local backoff now live in the canonical mutation executor; unique-queue evidence becomes a no-payload-blind-dedup guardrail.
invariant: retry timing/capacity may be shared by provider scope, but replay/coalescing authority remains action safety class plus explicit reconciliation
residual_gap: No known final-pass gap; provider-specific scopes must be declared by new mutation integrations.

decision_rationale: Caddy conditional mutation semantics were promoted out of a dormant compatibility manager into LumiNet’s actual durable config owner and every live HTTP config writer, then strengthened with durable generations and cross-store secret copy-on-write.
invariant: one durable config generation and one secret-aware commit boundary own mutation; stale writers cannot overwrite newer state
residual_gap: No known live config writer bypasses the Manager CAS path.

plane: DNS server/plugin runtime and load shedding
decision_rationale: CoreDNS exposes a powerful general plugin/runtime and shed mechanism. LumiNet already has narrower product-specific rate limiting, duplicate suppression, bounded/coalesced DoH refresh and cache ownership; another admission/plugin authority would add complexity without a measured uncovered bottleneck.
invariant: DNS admission, cache and retry bounds remain singular target owners
residual_gap: Revisit only if profiling identifies a concrete uncovered write/concurrency bottleneck.

plane: Unix firewall / DNS leak / broad network policy
decision_rationale: Peer firewall engines are broad and privileged. Importing their iptables/policy machinery would bypass LumiNet’s durable snapshot/apply/verify/recover/rollback host-network transaction. Unix DNS-leak protection therefore remains truthfully unsupported until modeled transactionally.
invariant: no privileged host-network mutation may bypass the canonical transaction owner
residual_gap: Unix DNS-leak protection is intentionally unsupported; implementing it requires a reversible HostNetworkChange, not raw peer rules.

decision_rationale: Firewalla’s IDS/alarm subsystem would introduce a new always-on packet-observation, data-retention and policy authority with a materially different product/privacy role. No isolated primitive currently beats LumiNet’s existing diagnostics sufficiently to justify that expansion.
invariant: diagnostics must not silently become surveillance or persistent policy authority
residual_gap: No general IDS plane in LumiNet; this is an explicit product-scope omission rather than missed code.

decision_rationale: Caddy’s inbound reverse-proxy/load-balancer is excellent but serves a different responsibility from LumiNet’s outbound client proxy/tunnel runtime. Porting it would create an inbound application-server product surface rather than strengthen an existing owner.
invariant: do not call role-mismatched mechanisms superseding implementations merely because both contain the word proxy
residual_gap: No inbound general-purpose reverse-proxy product plane is claimed.

decision_rationale: Caddy TLS automation belongs to an internet-facing server lifecycle. LumiNet does not currently own that server/certificate product role, so adopting ACME issuance/storage/renewal would expand authority without a consuming surface.
invariant: certificate automation must have a concrete serving authority and secret lifecycle before adoption
residual_gap: No general inbound ACME/certificate-serving plane is claimed.

plane: service desired-state scheduling and restart recovery
decision_rationale: InviZible’s unique-work/reconciliation semantics remain valuable, but LumiNet already owns periodic profile refresh and process supervision with stable-ready/backoff/recovery semantics. A second generic WorkManager would split scheduling authority.
invariant: one owner per durable schedule/process lifecycle; reconcile desired versus actual without duplicate workers
residual_gap: No generic job scheduler is added; add one only when multiple independent durable workflows require a shared persisted queue.

decision_rationale: Panel peers contain full user, billing, node and quota authorities. LumiNet extracted only the operator-useful entitlement projection—quota/expiry/exhaustion evidence—without importing a second user/billing database or allowing provider metadata to authorize connectivity.
invariant: entitlement is advisory derived evidence, never authentication, billing or connectivity authority
residual_gap: No multi-tenant billing/user-management product plane is claimed.

decision_rationale: WARP donor scanning concepts were rederived into bounded repeated handshakes, loss and median-RTT ranking, loss-first ordering and hard noise bounds, reusing LumiNet’s existing WARP owner.
invariant: quality measurement is bounded and advisory; noise generation cannot bypass runtime safety limits
residual_gap: No separate WARP scanner/installer authority remains necessary.

decision_rationale: Defyx quality/stability semantics were recomposed into bounded LumiNet diagnostics: median latency, min ping, adjacent-sample jitter, packet loss, stability and strict response/redirect byte budgets.
invariant: diagnostics must remain bounded, cancellable and non-authoritative
residual_gap: No upload benchmark plane is added without a safe endpoint/side-effect contract.

decision_rationale: Simple restart/NEWNYM loops are subsumed by LumiNet’s bounded Tor controller, process owner, circuit management and guard rotation. Another timer loop would weaken lifecycle/recovery ownership.
invariant: Tor identity changes occur through the canonical controller/process lifecycle and remain bounded/cancellable
residual_gap: No independent auto-IP loop is retained.

decision_rationale: GoodbyeDPI and related peers provide rich packet manipulation primitives, but LumiNet already has a cross-platform target-native evasion contract with platform adapters. Donor-specific raw packet engines remain evidence unless a discriminating target gap is proven.
invariant: all packet mutation must stay behind the target evasion contract and platform capability truth
residual_gap: Some donor tricks remain platform-specific reference material rather than claimed equivalence.

decision_rationale: Peer bootstrap scripts mix package installation, remote downloads, root mutations, certificates, cron and service changes. Some are unlicensed or non-transactional. They are retained as operational evidence, not imported as a privileged deployment authority.
invariant: deployment mutation must be reproducible, bounded, attributable and reversible where possible; remote scripts never gain authority by convenience
residual_gap: LumiNet still lacks a target-native replacement for every peer one-command VPS installer; this is deliberate.

decision_rationale: gologin demonstrates composable OAuth state/context handlers, but LumiNet’s control API is local privileged authentication and has no current social-login identity requirement. Adding provider OAuth would widen the identity/trust model rather than improve present authorization.
invariant: identity mechanisms are introduced only for an explicit actor/product need and must not weaken privileged local control auth
residual_gap: No social OAuth/OIDC login plane is claimed.

decision_rationale: Peer crypto/geodata mechanisms were already converged in earlier waves. Final re-audit found no primitive that justifies replacing LumiNet’s native crypto boundary or canonical geodata/routing owners.
invariant: cryptographic and routing data have one authoritative implementation/source path with explicit provenance
residual_gap: External dataset refresh remains subject to existing admission/provenance controls.

decision_rationale: Client catalogs provide compatibility/product discovery value but do not justify a new runtime authority. Supported configuration/protocol value is absorbed only through LumiNet profile parsing and canonical proxy cores.
invariant: catalog popularity is not runtime correctness evidence; imported presets cannot bypass schema/compatibility checks
residual_gap: Some catalog-only clients remain reference material.

decision_rationale: DNS command-and-control persistence, FTP-bounce scanning and interception/MITM surfaces remain negative/security evidence only. They do not become LumiNet production capabilities during convergence.
invariant: negative evidence may create tests/guardrails but cannot silently broaden production authority into offensive or covert capability
residual_gap: None; rejection is intentional and final for this scope.

decision_rationale: Three donor transport experiments converge into one registered client PT contract with narrow process authority and environment preflight.
invariant: untrusted API input chooses only registered transport semantics, never arbitrary binaries/flags; replacement happens only after successful preflight
residual_gap: Actual PT binary execution cannot be exercised in this offline container; availability is fail-closed and package-harness verified.

decision_rationale: External DoT-over-proxy composition and DNSEL semantics become a native authenticated encrypted-DNS path with explicit unknown diagnostics and optional active Tor SOCKS.
invariant: privacy proxy errors fail closed; DNSBL loopback data is evidence only; NXDOMAIN remains distinct from resolver failure
residual_gap: Real upstream DoH/DoT exchanges are not executed in the offline/local-toolchain environment.

decision_rationale: Atomic replacement semantics are consolidated behind one canonical watcher primitive; the runtime adapter deliberately owns notifications, not automatic reconciliation.
invariant: parent-directory watch survives rename publication; exact paths/debounce bound notifications
residual_gap: No production config auto-reconciliation owner currently consumes the adapter; promotion remains intentionally dormant to avoid split-brain runtime state.

decision_rationale: Robust loss/median/jitter and richer TLS peer metadata are available as evidence primitives but not falsely promoted to live routing authority.
invariant: measurement evidence stays bounded, explicit and separable from route selection authority
residual_gap: A live endpoint selector can consume the quality contract only after comparative production measurements and ownership review.

decision_rationale: Server relay/hidden-service deployment remains outside the client-engine role instead of becoming hidden root/firewall authority.
invariant: client Tor runtime owns client subprocess/circuit behavior only
residual_gap: No server/relay product plane is requested or safely owned by LumiNet.

decision_rationale: The archive is release metadata/readme rather than browser source and LumiNet has no browser execution surface.
invariant: browser privacy must have a browser-owned implementation and test surface
residual_gap: Network privacy does not provide browser-fingerprint protection; no false capability is advertised.

decision_rationale: Peer raw firewall/NAT/kill-switch mechanisms are explicitly rejected as parallel authority; the transactional HostNetworkChange model remains stronger.
invariant: privileged network changes require snapshot, verification, recovery and rollback ownership
residual_gap: Unix DNS-leak/firewall features remain unsupported until representable inside that transaction model.

decision_rationale: Auto-stop/lease intent is useful, but hard-coded cloud identity and root/Docker managers are not safe target deployment authority.
invariant: ephemeral infrastructure requires explicit identity, idempotent lease/teardown, audit and rollback
residual_gap: No new cloud deployment owner is introduced in this wave.
